summary: The confirmed_not_located closure stands for the original gene-level HFD-versus-chow results. All 75 manifest entries matched their recorded sizes and SHA-256 hashes, and all six proposed computations reproduced. The authors reported two discoveries. The registered analysis had zero among 21,906 published symbols. The corrected proposal documents three randomized cages per diet, the committed source hashes, and 402 genes that the notebook retained at exactly 10 reads but the paper’s stated rule would exclude. The proposal passed validation. [Study and Table 1](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10771486/)
openIssues: The two discovery IDs, original per-gene effects, and P and adjusted P values remain unlocated. Gene-level concordance remains unassessed.
The registered derived-count gzip was unavailable for rehashing. Its historical hash is recorded, and all 12 selected library totals matched the registered normalization table.
